decisions.reason: Making the print version conditional does not alter the required digital flipbook deliverable; the stated 6am preference is project launch timing rather than a deliverable-state change.
The print-production trigger does not change the digital flipbook's spread behavior, upload format, or even-page requirement.
The conditional need for printed copies does not change the flipbook platform cost requirement or candidate platforms.
The table of contents must remain accurate for the digital publication regardless of whether a print version is requested.
Image-quality enhancement remains necessary for the digital issue and is not conditioned on producing printed copies.
Accurate cover page references remain required for the digital publication and are unaffected by conditional print production.
The magazine still requires cohesive layout assembly for its digital output; only production of the separate print version became conditional.
The layout template remains necessary for the digital magazine and is not removed or changed by the print-production condition.
The inaugural-edition and issue-date metadata remain valid independently of whether printed copies are requested.
The tribute page remains part of the magazine's content and is not limited to the conditional print output.
Advertisements must still render clearly in the digital publication; making print production conditional does not alter that quality requirement.
The approved readable Inter treatment remains required for digital article pages and is unaffected by the conditional print deliverable.
